verdict.rationale: The standard llms.txt at the root domain returns 404, but probes show agent-friendly markdown docs (docs/get-started.md returns 200) that point to a Mintlify-hosted llms index, meaning an agent could be pointed at machine-readable docs via an indirect path rather than a canonical llms.txt. Missing for 10: a working llms.txt at the expected root URL, and clear first-party documentation advertising this llms/agent-doc endpoint as a supported entry point.
